headlines.title: Grand jury declines to indict former Trump aide Cassidy Hutchinson, star witness of Jan. 6 committee
headlines.description: The failed indictment is one of many for federal prosecutors during the second Trump administration.

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll roll back Biden-era methane rules for oil and gas companies
headlines.description: The EPA plans to ease regulations aimed at curbing methane leaks, Trump said. The potent greenhouse gas is a major contributor to climate change.

headlines.title: James Talarico faces off against Trump in dueling Texas rallies in election’s final days
headlines.description: Voter enthusiasm in Lubbock, a Texas city of fewer than 300,000, underscored the stakes of a close Senate race in what Democrats call their best chance in a generation.

headlines.title: ‘Manosphere’ that helped Trump to power seems to be moving away from him
headlines.description: The demographic of young men who helped President Trump return to power in 2024 may be rethinking their vote ahead of midterms. Some polling says their support of the president may be waning, as even some top influencers in the space have lower favorability than last year. NBC News’ Jon Allen reports.

headlines.title: Michigan Senate race reaches a boiling point
headlines.description: There are new tensions in the contentious Michigan Senate race, including controversial comments from Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and growing backlash to a new anti-Israel ad. NBC News’ Ryan Nobles reports.

headlines.title: House Democrat running in deep-red Arkansas says the race is ‘tight and winnable’
headlines.description: Democratic House candidate Chris Jones joins Meet the Press NOW one week to Election Day to discuss his plan to unseat incumbent Republican Rep. French Hill in Arkansas's second congressional district. Jones discusses what he says is the ‘corruption' coming out of the White House and whether President Trump should be impeached.

headlines.title: How Democrats could win the House, how the GOP could hang on, and where to look for a wave
headlines.description: Three 2026 election scenarios that show which party could end up in control of the U.S. House of Representatives.

headlines.title: Drive to Decision Day: Voters sound off on the economy, war and Washington
headlines.description: With the midterm elections almost here, NBC News’ Jonathan Allen wanted to find out if Americans are frustrated enough with President Trump and Republicans to vote Democrats into power in the House and Senate. So he hopped in a van and drove 1,800 miles from New Jersey to Nebraska to meet with voters in eight battleground districts.

headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.
